title: Rabbi Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 135b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.135b.5): “As the Tannaim dispute — Rabbi Chama says: she gave birth,” etc. This is also [Rashi’s reading from the She’iltot](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Shabbat.135b.3.2). Dikdukei Soferim has Rabbi Abba. Hyman suggests that possibly he is Rabbi Chama, the father of Rabbi Oshaya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The baraita as printed in the linked Shabbat gives Rav Chama. The same folio calls him Rabbi Chama in Rava’s discussion.
The linked Rashi quotes the She’iltot wording with Rabbi Chama. Hyman reports Rabbi Abba from Dikdukei Soferim and tentatively identifies the figure with Oshaya’s father.
